script: A Miami club is going to the U.S. Open Cup. In the UPSL national final, Miami United lost three to one to Deportivo Rose City at UCLA. But reaching the final earned them an automatic spot in the twenty twenty-seven U.S. Open Cup. It's their fifth main draw in their last six tries. Only thirty-two amateur clubs make it in, and half qualified automatically. Which South Florida club should join them? Tell us in the comments.
caption:
Miami United FC is going to the 2027 U.S. Open Cup. 🏆

The Miami club lost the 2026 UPSL Spring National Championship final 3-1 to Deportivo Rose City at UCLA, but reaching the final earned an automatic bid as runner-up.

It's their fifth Tournament Proper in their last six tries; their best run came in 2024, falling to Memphis 901 FC in the Third Round. 32 amateur Open Division clubs make the Tournament Proper, and 16 of them qualified automatically.

Which South Florida club should join them? Tell us in the comments 👇

Source: U.S. Soccer, "Meet the 16 Open Division Clubs That Automatically Qualified for the 2027 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup" (Aug 2026). Crest shown with the club's OK. Cancha is independent and not affiliated with U.S. Soccer or the UPSL.
